1.

On Golgotha it was so dark, For us no shadow remains, For Thou art our righteousness, O Jesus, crowned with glory.

2.

In Thee before our God we stand, To partake of His full favour; When Thou didst descend into death’s depths, A great company Thou didst gain as reward.

3.

Thou art exalted, yet still we see The love that endured the cross’s woe. Thou, who hast borne death here, Now livest for Thine own there.

4.

Our Lord Christ in heaven’s height, We praise Thee with holy joy; Yea, before Thee Thy ransomed host With reverence raises a shout of gladness.

5.

Thy power knows no bounds, Thy love is of eternity, Thy truth shall stand as the rock, When earth and heaven shall pass away.

6.

Thy love turns not back, Yesterday, today the same still, Son of God, who hast laid earth’s foundation, Lamb of God, who hast brought full atonement.
